I recently stayed at the Harbourview Inn in Charleston and wanted to share my experience. The location is unbeatable, just a short walk from the waterfront and all the great restaurants on East Bay. The room was clean and the staff were friendly, though the walls were a bit thin and I could hear the elevator ding all night. Breakfast was decent, not amazing.

Overall, a solid choice if you prioritize location over luxury. I'd stay again but might request a room away from the elevator.

I recently dined at the Sunset Grill in Santa Monica and had a mixed experience. The seafood was fresh and the view was stunning, but the service was slow and the prices were high. Our waiter seemed overwhelmed, and it took forever to get our check. I might give it another try on a special occasion, but for a casual dinner, it's not worth the splurge.

On a side note, the valet parking is expensive ($20), so consider parking on the street if you can find a spot.
